caption: The drawing depicts a suit of men’s clothing, consisting of a long, brownish coat with buttons, a navy blue vest with gold buttons, a white collared shirt, and brown trousers. The coat is knee-length, slightly textured, and worn open to reveal the fitted vest beneath it. The shirt underneath is white, with a stand-up collar, and the coat’s sleeves are long with cuffs that hang loosely at the wrists. The trousers are loose-fitting and have a smooth, matte appearance. The clothes are displayed without a visible wearer; the neck is left as a plain, rounded shape without any head or facial features. The composition is centered on the outfit, rendered in realistic colors with careful shading and texture to represent the fabric. On the right side of the drawing is a small, simple line sketch of the same outfit, showing its back view with minimal detail. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Shaker Man's Costume
